description:
## Goal

Add a structured `introspect` subcommand to the shared cli-core package. Every scenario CLI inherits it automatically. Default human output contract for other commands is unchanged.

## Expected Work

- Implement introspect per the research contract.
- Emit the command tree as JSON to stdout (introspect is machine-targeted; it is the explicit exception to the default human output rule).
- Auto-generation via reflection over the CLI framework so no per-scenario wiring is needed.
- Verify it works on at least 3 existing scenario CLIs without any per-scenario changes.

## Acceptance

- Every scenario CLI responds to `introspect` with a valid JSON command tree.
- Existing human output behavior unchanged for all other commands.
- Output matches the research-defined schema.
name: cli-core-introspect-command
title: Implement the `introspect` command in cli-core
